entries.topic: Cold War layer of the network: the Bank of Israel, the Knesset building, the Nation Associates and the oil connection (Nov 2026)
claims: 24 Aug 1954: the Knesset passed the Bank of Israel Law; the central bank is state-owned (Ministry of Finance).
David Horowitz was the first governor, for 17 years.
Before 1954 the currency was issued by the Anglo-Palestine Bank (Bank Leumi from 1950).
James de Rothschild left £1.25M in his will for the Knesset building (announced July 1957); inaugurated 30 Aug 1966.
Senate record: $5,100,001.02 from the Jewish Agency to the Council, 1955-62 (Barda gives $1.5M; unreconciled).
1948: Max Ball, head of the Interior Department's oil and gas division, met Eliahu Epstein of the Jewish Agency; Gendzier calls it the basis of the "oil connection" (from Ball's papers).
Eliahu Epstein, the Jewish Agency's representative in Washington.
1943: Freda Kirchwey created the Nation Associates, a sponsor-funded nonprofit, when she sold her ownership of The Nation.
Letters to Truman of 10 May and 19 June 1948.
May 1947: Kirchwey gave UN delegates a 75-page dossier from the Mufti's files arguing the Arab Higher Committee was in "active partnership with Rome and Tokyo".
Submissions to the UN in May 1947 and June 1948 (the second on King Farouk's and the Mufti's Nazi ties).
June 1948 memorandum: "The record of collaboration of King Farouk of Egypt with the Nazis and their ally, the Mufti".
